copies.public/_headers: generated by site-runtime-headers from the site's registry entry, the set the Worker applies; the build rewrites it
copies.scripts/verify-mcp.mjs: the admin MCP's live gate: devkit worker-deploy runs its verify-command in a fresh checkout with no install, so it may import only node: builtins (importing site-runtime's errorMessage rolled back every MCP deploy from #848)
copies.app/lib/markdown-twin.ts: the post twin's own negotiation: prefersMarkdown goes through the site's prefersType (negotiate.mjs), which every negotiated route shares, and markdownResponse sends Vary: Accept only on the never-stored negotiated variant, so the stored .md twin stays one cache entry

tokens.--text: the site's own palette (app.css's theme blocks, checked by scripts/check-contrast.mjs) still names it, until the site's colors move into Capsomer's purple family and its site layer
tokens.--scrim: the site's own palette (app.css's theme blocks, checked by scripts/check-contrast.mjs) still names it, until the site's colors move into Capsomer's purple family and its site layer
tokens.--line-strong: the site's own palette (app.css's theme blocks, checked by scripts/check-contrast.mjs) still names it, until the site's colors move into Capsomer's purple family and its site layer
tokens.--z-progress: Capsomer's reading bar sits above the pinned header on this site's own stacking scale (900), as it always has; Capsomer's scale tops out at 90; moves to Capsomer's site layer with the manual look
tokens.--line-w: the manual look's one-pixel rule, in rem so it scales with text size, where Capsomer's scale uses px; moves to Capsomer's site layer with the manual look
tokens.--line-w-thick: the manual look's two-pixel rule, in rem; same reason as --line-w
tokens.--radius-control: the manual look's square controls (0), where Capsomer rounds them by --radius-m; moves to Capsomer's site layer with the manual look
